description: Write and organize notes with titles, instant search and last-edited timestamps. Everything is saved in your browser, and you can export all notes as a .txt file.

faqs.a: Your notes live in your browser's localStorage on this device only. They are not uploaded anywhere, so clearing site data or switching devices will lose them unless you export first.
Yes — click "Export All (.txt)" at any time to download every note with its title and last-edited timestamp as a plain text file.
faqs.q: Can I back up my notes?

faqs.a: No, notes are private to this browser. They never leave your device — the export file is the only way to move them elsewhere.
faqs.q: Are my notes synced between devices?

howto: Click "New Note" and give it a title.
Write the note body — your changes save automatically.
Use the search box to filter your notes instantly.
Select a note to edit it, or export everything as .txt.
title: Notes App
